what: Score records of the detector core with a hidden layer, on small cases. Every expected score was worked BY HAND from the definition in model/detector.py's docstring, steps 4a to 4d, and the sums are written out in each case's 'worked' lines. Nothing here was produced by the model.
definition: y, r and z as in vectors/mod-b/datapath.json. u_j[i] = sum over k of hidden[j][k] * z_k[i]; t_j[i] = floor(u_j[i] / 2^hidden_shift); b_j = t_j (between 0, pass) or |t_j| (between 1, abs); a[i] = sum over j of head[j] * b_j[i]; score[i] = floor(a[i] / 2^score_shift). floor is toward minus infinity: floor(-11 / 2) = -6.
format: As vectors/mod-b/datapath.json, and in config: hidden is a list of units, each one weight for each filter, in filter order; hidden_shift; between; head is one weight for each hidden unit.

cases.name: s16x1-two-units-abs-both-shifts
cases.why: Two filters, two units, abs between, and a shift at each place, with an odd negative value at each so that the two floors show: at i = 1 the first unit's sum is -11, and at i = 3 the output sum is -13. A hidden shift that rounded toward zero would give t_0 = -5 at i = 1 and a score of 3 there; a between that passed would give 3*(-6) - 8 = -26 and a score of -13 there; a score shift that rounded toward zero would give -6 at i = 3.

cases.name: s16x1-two-units-pass-after-an-abs-bank-and-a-pool
cases.why: The same filters and frames behind an abs rectifier and a pool of 2, with pass between and no shift: the bank's rectifier and the layer's are two settings. A between that took the absolute value would give 5*1 + 3*3 = 14 at i = 0.
worked: y0 = 2, -3, 4, 3 and y1 = 1, -5, 9, -9, as in the case above

cases.name: s24x3-two-units-abs-channels-differ
cases.why: Three channels with different values, a filter across channels 0 and 2 and one on channel 1, a pool of 2, abs between, a hidden shift of 2 and a score shift of 1. Six of the eight hidden sums are negative, and five of those are not multiples of 4: -25, -29, -2, -9 and -17. The first two output sums are -1, whose floor by 2 is -1, not 0.

cases.name: s24x3-three-units-pass-on-channel-1
cases.why: Three units on one filter, on the middle channel, pass between: the units' signs survive. With abs between the first score would be 4 + 9 - 13 = 0. More units than filters, so a head that took its count from the filters would be wrong.
